new.story: A 2002 ten-cent euro coin from Germany, from the first year of the euro. The German side shows the Brandenburg Gate in Berlin inside a ring of twelve stars, with the date and the D of the Munich mint below.
new.notes: Phase 1 from the national side only. The Gate design is shared by 10, 20 and 50 cent; 10 cent per the owner (via Muse) and the plain edge. Confirm at Phase 2 from the value side.
